# About Reveal

We are a dream team with talent and expertise stretching back to the beginnings of eDiscovery. We've created industry-defining frameworks, processes, and technologies. We've been law firm partners and associates, corporate paralegals and eDiscovery managers, ALSP consultants, and, of course, software developers. We've launched new companies, some part of Reveal today, built legal department capabilities, and worked on some of the most complex, challenging, and high-stakes eDiscovery matters ever. We are Reveal.

Together, we do our jobs for you. We aspire and strive to create the very best AI-powered platform. We do this by working together in Chicago and across the world, listening carefully to our clients, and creating a platform that enables you to do your very best job.

## What we do

Reveal builds and supports a leading AI-powered platform for [eDiscovery](https://www.revealdata.com/use-case/ediscovery), [investigations](https://www.revealdata.com/use-case/investigations), and related activities. With industry-leading artificial intelligence capabilities and visual [analytics](https://www.revealdata.com/use-case/analytics-visualization), our platform covers all phases of the EDRM from information governance through presentation. Our technology is used by organizations of all types, sizes, and levels of sophistication to uncover more useful information faster and get to actionable insights sooner.

## Our mission

Our mission is to provide a seamless end-to-end technology solution powered by industry-leading AI that enables organizations to accelerate workflows and reduce eDiscovery costs.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/663507390264203b5ada17aa_Office.avif)

## Our AI pledge

Reveal pledges to follow the responsible use of data when developing AI models — employing trustworthy practices, knowledgeable practitioners, and secure methodologies.

- We never use client data for AI models without explicit permission from the client
- We build AI models using knowledgeable and trained professionals
- We use security measures tailored to the privacy needs of those whose data is used in creating models

Learn more at

[AI Pledge](https://www.revealdata.com/ai-pledge)

## Our history

Laser focused on building for the future.

May, 2024

[Onna](https://onna.com/) Acquisition. Reveal acquires Onna to significantly enhance how data is managed from common digital workplace tools.

January, 2024

APAC Expansion. Reveal announces opening of new office Hyderabad, India. The focus of that office will be on software development, AI, Generative AI, and deployment support.

August, 2023

IPRO Acquisition. Reveal acquires IPRO as part of a dual acquisition to bring Reveal's AI-powered ecosystem to clients across the globe.

August, 2023

[Logikcull](https://www.logikcull.com/) Acquisition. Reveal acquires Logikcull to create a unified platform to democratize access to legal AI and automate the practice of law.

March, 2023

LIGL Acquisition. Reveal acquires LIGL, a comprehensive legal hold technology solution with 40+ data connectors, in-place preservation, and workflow automation.

October, 2022

Technically Creative Acquisition. Reveal acquires Technically Creative allowing deployment of robust data connectors to expand governance and compliance workflows within Reveal.

March, 2022

Launch of Reveal 11. Reveal releases the industry’s first fully integrated AI-powered platform, seamlessly combining the best of Brainspace, Reveal AI, and Reveal Review.

January, 2021

[Brainspace](https://www.revealdata.com/product/brainspace) Acquisition. Reveal acquires Brainspace after partnering in 2017, executing upon our vision of bringing together the industry’s two premier AI technology platforms.

January, 2021

Capital Investment. Reveal receives $250M investment from K1 Investment Management to accelerate growth.

August, 2020

NexLP Acquisition. Reveal acquires NexLP (now Reveal AI) and its data science team after spending 18 months partnering and integrating software platforms.

June, 2019

Mindseye Acquisition. Reveal acquires Mindseye Solutions and their industry-leading processing technology.

November, 2018

Capital Investment. Reveal receives investment from Galland Capital Partners to accelerate growth.

January, 2016

Cloud Implementation. Reveal partners with AWS and redesigns its platform to be one of the industry’s first cloud-native applications.

April, 2015

EMEA Expansion. Reveal expands its physical footprint into Europe with the opening of the EMEA Headquarters in Dublin, Ireland.

January, 2009

Product Launch. Reveal enters the legal technology market with v1.0.
